title: Attribute admission-binding time on the host: state-lock wait/hold and work-binding CLI subprocess timings on the admission card
outcome: When queued admission ends with deadline_exceeded in admission_binding, the card or trace records how the budget was spent on the host: time waiting for and holding the state mutex, each work-binding CLI subprocess (read_work_binding and held-claims reads) from spawn to exit, and each control frame. Then a 20 s admission can be attributed to the host or to Engram without guesswork.
acceptance: Admission phase timings are recorded per phase (mutex wait, mutex hold, each CLI read subprocess, each control frame) and surfaced on the degraded card or in a bounded trace. A test with a scripted slow CLI reader and a held state lock shows the time attributed to the right phase.

On the live host, the per-phase breakdown is recorded for a real admission (any queued admission in ordinary operation, not a constructed burst), showing every phase field populated end to end, and the observed breakdown is recorded on this item for Engram w-58af6958d8ae. No synthetic concurrent-burst reproduction is required (Greg's direction, b9d13887 #997).
